day3_night_start_2.text: *I took a shower and came out. My phone screen is lit up. Notifications.*

day3_night_sea_msg.text: *Sea: '{name}, today was fun. Let's go together tomorrow.' -- 10:02 PM*

day3_night_sea_msg_2.text: *I didn't read it. I put the phone down while brushing my teeth.*

day3_night_sea_msg_3.text: *1 minute later. Buzz. Sea: 'Reply before you go to sleep' — 10:03 PM*

day3_night_sea_msg_5.text: *A speech bubble with only three dots clings to the bottom of the chat window.*

day3_night_sea_msg_9.text: *Six messages in 13 minutes. The unread bubbles filled an entire screen. The timestamp on the last bubble kept catching my eye.*

day3_night_sea_msg_10.text: *I flipped the phone face down. It still buzzes.*

day3_night_sea_msg_11.text: *Buzz. Again. I told myself I wouldn't check the screen, but my hand reaches for it.*

day3_night_sea_msg_12.text: *Sea: 'You left the window open, right? Air it out before bed' — 10:19 PM*

day3_night_sea_msg_13.text: *The window? My thumb stops over the reply button.*

day3_night_sea_msg_14.text: *I look at the window. The curtain is open. It's dark outside. I can't see anything.*

day3_night_sea_msg_15.text: *In the glass window of the building across from me, the small rectangle of my room is reflected.*

day3_night_sea_msg_16.text: *I closed the curtain. Put the phone in the drawer. Closed the drawer.*

day3_night_sea_msg_17.text: *...It buzzes again from inside the drawer.*

day3_night_bleed.text: *I lie under the covers in the dark. A rectangle of streetlight falls across the ceiling.*

day3_night_bleed_2.text: *The photos Yuna showed me. Other name tags line up against the inside of my eyelids.*

day3_night_bleed_3.text: *The name tags change, but the small spot near the eye stays in the same place.*

day3_night_bleed_4.text: *I close my eyes. But the photos switch on behind my eyelids. 13 ID photos in a row. Different hair colors. Different name tags. The same eyes.*

day3_night_bleed_no_yuna_1.text: *I never saw the photos. The note, the writing on the wall, and Sea's messages all overlap.*

day3_night_bleed_no_yuna_2.text: *I memorized the direction of the school staircases before my classmates' names.*

day3_night_bleed_no_yuna_3.text: *The harder I try to trace it, the more gaps appear.*

day3_night_bleed_5.text: *When I close my eyes, the scenes connect in sequence.*

day3_night_bleed_6.text: *The hallway on the first day. My feet turned toward the vending machine before the sign could tell me where to go.*

day3_night_bleed_7.text: *Before I saw the nameplate for the faculty office, my hand was already pointing down the right hallway.*

day3_night_bleed_7a.text: *The yellow anti-slip tape on the second-floor landing. That color felt familiar from the very first day I saw it.*

day3_night_bleed_8.text: *The stroke bending left inside the locker. It's the same angle as the final stroke in my notebook.*

day3_night_bleed_9.text: *Seolhwa's gaze always reached my left hand before my right.*

day3_night_bleed_10.text: *Sea never once packed a side dish I hated in her lunchbox.*

day3_night_bleed_10a.text: *Minsu's speech bubble was spelled far too neatly. His profile picture was still the gray default image.*

day3_night_bleed_11.text: *When I try to picture the gate of my old school, white walls appear first. Nothing comes after.*

day3_night_bleed_12.text: *The classroom at my old school. White walls. A white board. A faceless teacher. In the seat beside me, there is only the shadow of a desk.*

day3_night_bleed_13.text: *I breathed in. The ceiling pattern looked one square closer at a time.*

day3_night_bleed_14.text: ***There is only the phrase 'old school,' and no place attached to it.***

day3_night_bleed_15.text: *I sat up. Sweat beads on my forehead. My hands are shaking. The plastic feel of the name tag still clings to my fingertips.*

day3_night_stat_crack.text: *I lay back down. Closed my eyes.*

day3_night_stat_crack_2.text: *The compartments of Sea's lunchbox. The warmth of Ms. Eunsu's palm. The rim of the teacup Riin handed me.*

day3_night_stat_crack_3.text: *Everything faces the same direction: toward where I sit.*

day3_night_stat_crack_4.text: *The space between the bed and the desk looks narrower than usual. It isn't as if the room has shrunk.*

day3_night_stat_crack_4a.text: *I drew a deep breath, but it stopped halfway in.*

day3_night_stat_crack_6.text: *No. Nothing's there. My eyes are just tired.*

day3_night_ft_nightmare.text: *I close my eyes. Images flood through the darkness.*

day3_night_ft_nightmare_2.text: *I'm walking down a hallway. No end in sight. Each step I take — the hallway stretches longer.*

day3_night_ft_nightmare_3.text: *I opened a classroom door. Same classroom. Opened another. Same classroom. Same seats, same people. Same smiles. All looking at me.*

day3_night_ft_nightmare_4.text: *Names crowd the blackboard. Kim Dojin. Park Jaewon. Lee Sehun. ...Twelve lines. Only the bottom line is empty — my seat.*

day3_night_ft_nightmare_5.text: *I look at the clock. It has stopped. No—the second hand is moving backward.*

day3_night_ft_nightmare_6.text: *A voice from somewhere. Close, far, all around. ...But there's no door out.*

day3_night_wall.text: *I can't fall asleep. After tossing and turning for a long time, I finally drifted off.*

day3_night_wall_2.text: *3 AM. I got up to use the bathroom. My head feels heavy.*

day3_night_wall_3.text: *I walk down the hallway without turning on the light. The floor is cold under my feet. ...I stopped.*

day3_night_wall_4.text: *There is writing on the wall. Faintly visible in the streetlight. In pencil. In my handwriting.*

day3_night_wall_6.text: *I stopped breathing. I turned on the light. The fluorescent flickers on. The writing becomes clearly visible.*

day3_night_wall_7.text: *When I move closer to the wall, I smell graphite. The smell of a pencil just sharpened.*

day3_night_wall_8.text: *I touched the writing with my hand. Pencil graphite smudges onto my fingertips. This was written recently. It's not a dried mark.*

day3_night_wall_9.text: *I looked at my hands. Right index finger. Clean. ...Left hand. Pencil marks on my left index and middle finger. The first joint of my index finger is blackened.*

day3_night_wall_10.text: *The strokes are left-handed. The letters press down a little more as they move from left to right.*

day3_night_wall_11.text: *I looked around the room. A pencil is lying on the desk. I didn't leave it there earlier. I put it in the drawer. There is a little graphite on the drawer handle, too.*

day3_night_wall_12.text: *The pencil is on the desk and graphite marks the drawer handle. I remember nothing between those two moments.*

day3_night_seolhwa.text: *I am looking at the writing on the wall. The air changes. The temperature drops. The fluorescent light flickers once.*

day3_night_seolhwa_2.text: *Someone is standing in the corner of the room.*

day3_night_seolhwa_3.text: *Cold creeps up from my toes. The room temperature just changed.*

day3_night_seolhwa_4.text: *It is the girl by the window. Silver-white hair. A school uniform. My room in the dead of night. The door is locked, and the entryway sensor light never came on.*

day3_night_seolhwa_4a.text: *I didn't hear the front door. No footsteps either.*

day3_night_seolhwa_4b.text: *She is looking at {name}. Tears at the corners of her eyes catch pinpricks of streetlight.*

day3_night_seolhwa_6a.text: *My voice won't come out. My lips are dry.*

day3_night_seolhwa_7.text: Within five days... you have to get out of here.

day3_night_seolhwa_7a.text: *Her voice doesn't seem to come from the room. It follows a beat late.*

day3_night_seolhwa_8.text: Before you end up like me.

day3_night_seolhwa_9.text: Like you? What happened to you?

day3_night_seolhwa_10.text: *She reaches toward {name}'s face, then stops just before making contact.*

day3_night_seolhwa_11.text: *Her fingertips lose focus in front of my eyes. The streetlight outside the window and the outline of the back of her hand overlap, each a beat out of step.*

day3_night_seolhwa_11a.text: *A thin line fell from the girl's eye, then disappeared into the light.*

day3_night_seolhwa_13.text: *I blink. The girl is gone. There is nothing where she stood. No footprints on the floor.*

day3_night_seolhwa_14.text: *Only the air where I was standing is cold. The fluorescent light still hums, very low.*

day3_night_seolhwa_15.text: *I went to where she had been standing. Touched the floor. It's cold. Definitely colder than the surrounding area. ...That's all.*

day3_night_seolhwa_16.text: *The writing on the wall is still there. 'Get out of here.' I look at my left hand. My pencil-stained fingers slowly curl, then straighten.*

day3_night_seolhwa_17.text: *The wall clock's second hand sounds unnaturally clear. With every tick, my eyes return to the writing on the wall.*

day3_night_seolhwa_18.text: *Between the ticking of the clock, scenes from today cut in out of order.*

day3_night_investigate.text: *As soon as I close my eyes, the old building's doorknob and thirteen photographs line up in sequence. My phone still displays the writing from the wall.*

day3_night_investigate_2.text: *I took a photo of the writing on the wall. After the shutter sound, my left hand appeared small at the bottom of the screen.*

day3_night_deny.text: *It's my first week after transferring. When you're tired, even stains on a wall can look like writing.*

day3_night_deny_2.text: *I pulled the covers over myself. Closed my eyes. The writing on the wall lingers behind my eyelids.*

day3_night_ghost_ok.text: Will I see it again if I turn off the lights?

day3_xover_glitch_1.text: *I see a hallway. This isn't my room.*

day3_xover_glitch_2.text: *Someone is standing there. At the end of the corridor. A pale silhouette.*

day3_xover_glitch_4.text: That time too. And before that. Every time.

day3_xover_glitch_6.text: *I opened my eyes. My room. ...Was it a dream.*
